title: Compactifying real analytic functions and resulting Reeb spaces
summary: We formulate compactifications of continuous maps naturally. We consider real analytic functions mainly. We are interested in topological properties and combinatorial ones of explicit resulting maps. For understanding them, we use their Reeb spaces, being quotient spaces of the spaces of the domains of the functions and defined by the equivalence relation identifying two points in same components of their level sets.
